findings.title: API secrets in workspace .env
findings.evidence: .env gitignored (.gitignore:19); OPENAI_API_KEY expected from environment at runtime
findings.recommendation: Rotate if exposed; git log --all --full-history -- .env; never commit .env

findings.title: Path traversal in upload_md
findings.evidence: Path("./test_knowledge/" + file.filename) then open/write
findings.recommendation: Use Path(file.filename).name or UUID basename; reject .. and absolute paths

findings.title: Unsafe dynamic SQL identifiers for vector tables
findings.evidence: embeddings_model -> knowledge_table_name -> text(f'TRUNCATE TABLE "ai"."{table_name}"...')
findings.recommendation: Allowlist embedder names; quote_ident or strict validation

findings.title: CORS wildcard with allow_credentials
findings.evidence: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True
findings.recommendation: Explicit allow_origins; disable credentials unless required

findings.title: API error responses include exception text
findings.evidence: Global handler and routes return detail=f"... {exc}"
findings.recommendation: Generic detail for clients; logger.exception server-side only

findings.title: No authentication on RAG HTTP API
findings.evidence: No auth; GET /chat_history/ returns stored messages
findings.recommendation: Localhost-only docs; API keys or reverse-proxy auth if exposed

findings.title: SSRF risk on add_url server-side fetch
findings.evidence: requests.get(url) in scrape_url_to_document without host blocklist
findings.recommendation: Block private/link-local hosts; allowlist; cap redirects and body size

findings.title: Unbounded file uploads
findings.evidence: upload_md/upload_pdf no max size on UploadFile
findings.recommendation: Enforce upload limits and rate limits

findings.title: Global session_state mutable without locking
findings.evidence: Module-level SessionState updated by async handlers without locks
findings.recommendation: Per-session state or locks; document single-user assumption

findings.title: Hardcoded default PostgreSQL URL and credentials
findings.evidence: postgresql+psycopg2://ai:ai@localhost:5532/ai duplicated in pgVector.py
findings.recommendation: Environment-driven URL for non-local deployments

findings.title: RAG client double round-trip via server_info
findings.evidence: _ensure_server_compatible on every _request except /server_info/
findings.recommendation: Cache compatibility per process with TTL

findings.title: runner.py god object
findings.evidence: 1790-line module combining CLI, parallelism, GT, reporting, dashboard
findings.recommendation: Split into focused modules

findings.title: Dual better_shell entry (root shim)
findings.evidence: Root module re-exports BetterShellTools from debug_assistant_latest
findings.recommendation: Single documented import path

findings.title: Duplicate DB_URL literals
findings.evidence: Same connection string as runtime_config.DB_URL_PSYCOPG2
findings.recommendation: Import shared constant

findings.title: Dead triple-quoted old route in api_server
findings.evidence: ''' ... old clear_knowledge_base ... ''' not executed
findings.recommendation: Remove; use git history

findings.title: Unrestricted programmatic config_overrides merge
findings.evidence: merge_config_overrides applies any dotted_key; CLI overrides mapped only
findings.recommendation: Allowlist keys for library API or document trusted callers only

findings.title: Hardcoded MODEL_PRICES; unknown models to $0
findings.evidence: MODEL_PRICES NEED TO VERIFY; unknown models cost 0
findings.recommendation: External pricing table or provider API

findings.title: requirements.txt lower bounds only
findings.evidence: All dependencies use >= without upper cap
findings.recommendation: Lockfile or cap major versions

findings.title: Minimal tests for API and security surfaces
findings.evidence: Two main test files + fixtures; no FastAPI route tests for uploads/SSRF/auth
findings.recommendation: Add TestClient tests for critical API behavior

findings.title: Mixed camelCase/snake_case and comment typos
findings.evidence: configFile, debugAgent; #initilize #enviornment
findings.recommendation: PEP 8 for new code; fix typos

findings.title: Transitive pygments CVE (pip-audit)
findings.evidence: pip-audit -r requirements.txt on 2026-03-26: pygments CVE-2026-4539
findings.recommendation: Upgrade pygments/parents; run pip-audit in CI
